# FOS Essentials

> Unity tools for VRChat worlds, built on UdonSharp by French Oasis Studio.
> Every pack requires FOS Essentials Core, which is free.

Unity 2022.3.22f1 - VRChat SDK Worlds 3.10.4 - Built-in render pipeline.

## Packs

- [FOS Essentials Core](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/packs/core/): The shared foundation of every FOS Essentials tool: base behaviour, logging, ownership, player registry, localized inspectors and the Hub. Version 1.3.0, free.
- [FOS Teleport](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/packs/teleport/): One-way teleport, triggered by interaction, by a trigger volume or by a UI button. Version 1.0.0, free.
- [FOS UI Culling](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/packs/ui-culling/): Disables world UIs when the local player is out of range, from a single central manager. Version 1.0.0, free.
- [FOS Mirror](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/packs/mirror/): Switches mirrors on and off by distance, by button or by interaction, from a single central manager, with quality presets and a cost estimate. Version 1.0.0, free.
- [FOS Localization](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/packs/localization/): Translates the text and images of a world into as many languages as you want, with a table editor, CSV import and export, and the player's choice remembered between visits. Version 1.0.0, free.
- [FOS Sync Doctor](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/packs/sync-doctor/): Audits the synchronised behaviours of a world for the mistakes that never raise an error: late joiners, ownership, and broadcast events acting on the local player. Version 1.1.0, free.
- [FOS Access](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/packs/access/): Answers one question — does this player hold the key? A list in the inspector, a list downloaded from a URL, a VRChat product and the instance master, all cumulative, plus a gate that shows or hides objects accordingly. Version 1.0.0, free.
- [FOS Tablet System — Standard](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/packs/tablet-system/): A tablet players summon in front of them: teleport menu, local toggles, world rules, and a full moderation panel with roles, freeze, isolation, mute and a synchronised log. Version 2.1.0, paid.
- [FOS Tablet System — Pro](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/packs/tablet-system-pro/): Turns the four fixed roles into as many as your world needs, each with its own permissions, plus per-account roles, per-role visibility and per-role spawn points. Version 1.0.0, paid.
- [FOS Lock Door System — Standard](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/packs/lock-door-system/): A door players lock behind them: who is inside, do-not-disturb, anonymous mode, a doorbell with a camera view, and passages reserved to whoever holds the key. Version 2.0.0, paid.

## Guides

- [All packs](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/catalog/): the full catalogue, free and paid.
- [Installation](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/start/installation/): requirements and setup.
- [Compatibility](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/start/compatibility/): which pack needs which Core version.
- [FAQ](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/faq/): Quest, requirements, dependencies, updating.
- [Making a VRChat world multilingual](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/guides/multilingual-vrchat-world/): How to translate the text and images of a VRChat world, why parallel arrays break, and how to remember a visitor's language between visits.
- [Mirrors and frame rate in VRChat worlds](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/guides/vrchat-mirror-performance/): Why mirrors cost so much in a VRChat world, what a mirror actually renders, and how to keep them without wrecking performance on PC and Quest.
- [Udon sync mistakes that never raise an error](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/guides/vrchat-udon-sync-mistakes/): The VRChat networking bugs that compile cleanly and look right on your own machine: late joiners, ownership, and events that act on the wrong player.
- [Moderating a VRChat world](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/guides/vrchat-world-moderation/): What a world creator can and cannot do about disruptive visitors in VRChat, and how in-world moderation tools with roles actually work.
- [World UI and draw calls in VRChat](https://essentials.frenchoasis.studio/guides/vrchat-world-ui-performance/): Why world-space canvases cost frames even when nobody looks at them, and how distance culling keeps a UI-heavy VRChat world fast.
